# Maxime Haegeman

> AI Engineer based in Copenhagen, Denmark. Builds LLM systems, agents and retrieval (RAG) on top of solid data engineering foundations. Background in data and ML engineering: PySpark, Airflow, Databricks, MLflow.

This is a static personal website. Everything on it is public and can be cited.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.maximehaegeman.com/): intro, skills, featured projects and an interactive contact terminal
- [AI Lab](https://www.maximehaegeman.com/lab.html): live in-browser experiments, namely hybrid semantic search (BM25 + MiniLM embeddings + reciprocal rank fusion) and an agent trace replay viewer
- [Projects](https://www.maximehaegeman.com/projects.html): open-source data, ML and LLM projects pulled from GitHub
- [Blog](https://www.maximehaegeman.com/blog.html): articles on data engineering, machine learning and AI systems, published on Medium
